title: In the arcade
content: I had a Mall World dream last night that took place in the arcade, and it made me realize that my arcade dreams almost always have these recurring elements: - noticing or searching for quarters on the ground - can't decide what game to play - overly dark room - something scary or disconcerting: either a few games with really violent imagery that I try not to look at, or getting lost, or just a sense of dread Does anyone else experience these parts of the arcade?
